title: Setting up conditional states in battle

posts.author: CuteWolfGames
posts.body:
I apologize if this has been posted on/explained before, I have tried to look around but haven't found anything that can quite help me yet!
Hello RPG Maker community! I am, slowly, learning how to use the engine, and have been working on a tutorial battle intended to introduce some of the basic mechanics of my battle system, however, I am running into some problems inducing condition based elements in the battle itself.
I have a skill that requires TP that I want to force the player to use, but only when it would make sense to use it. As TP will be generated from a physical attack, I want the battle to prompt the player to use the skill only after a successful physical attack has occurred.
I believe I understand that the way to force a player to use a specific skill is best accomplished through sealing skills and attaching those sealed skills to a state, however, setting up the conditional branching to only trigger this state after a successful attack is proving to be difficult. I am sure I am missing something simple, and I am hopeful that this wonderful team of talented indie developers can point me in the right direction.
So far this is what I have.
First, I have created a State called "Attacked" I have built this for tracking purposes so that the system can track when the enemy unit has indeed been attacked.
Next, in the Battle Event, I am attempting to set up the condition that when this enemy is effected by Attacked the switch "successful attack" will switch to "ON"
Next, I have a condition set to check once per battle that if the switch "successful attack" is ON then I should switch the State Tutorial 1
Tutorial 1 should then seal away the rest of the skills from the player.
I can see via Icons that the state Attacked is applying to the enemy during a successful attack, however the switch doesn't seem to be inducing the state of Tutorial 1.
Can anyone advise me on what I might be doing incorrectly? Any thoughts or insights would be incredibly welcome. Thanks again!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
your problem is that the troop event 1 does not run as you assumed.
Condition Turn 0 means that it will only run on turn 0 (which is before battle) and never later.
you need to run it every turn, so either turn 1*x or turn end as a condition
additionally, the span determines how often a troop event can be triggered: once per battle, once per turn or once per moment/action.
since you want it to happen several times during battle, you'll need to change the span to turn as well.
EDIT: and you should probably split troop event 1: the messages only once on turn 0, but the check for the state in a different troop event once per turn
EDIT2: And sealing the escape skill does nothing, the party command escape doesn't use that skill. that skill is intended for use by enemies only.
